name: Lumbier (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Lumbier (a white tower between a star and a crescent on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Lumbier; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
